entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. I believe this
marks
our
first
interaction
in
this
clubroom.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_00

entries.text: I hope your Agias hasn’t suffered any...\naftereffects from the other day?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_02

entries.text: Nah, it’s doing great!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_select_01

entries.text: We’ve been flying a lot!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_select_02

entries.text: That is a relief.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_03

entries.text: Seeing it consume such a quantity of that\nsupplement caused me some concern.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_04

entries.text: Perhaps Agias’s sturdy constitution has shielded it\nfrom any ill effects.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_05

entries.text: I suspect it would be dangerous to let any other\nPokémon eat as much of the supplement.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_06

entries.text: Since I usually ride my Skarmory for the Flying\nTime Trial, I have not had the opportunity to test\r\nsuch matters myself.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_07

entries.text: I have nothing else to report. Let us conclude this\nconversation.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp01_08

entries.text: I have a question, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_00

entries.text: How was it that you and Kieran first met?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_01

entries.text: On a school trip!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_select_01

entries.text: We paired up!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_select_02

entries.text: So it was a trip that started it all?\c\nI do recall that Kieran and Carmine returned to\nKitakami shortly before Kieran’s...change.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_02

entries.text:
P-paired?!\c
...Ahem. Pardon me.\c
I understand now that you mean you undertook
your school trip activities as a pair.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_02b

entries.text: I have been wondering why your presence\nprovoked such intense reactions from Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_03

entries.text: Based on what you’ve said, I doubt that the\ncircumstances of your meeting were the cause.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_04

entries.text: My question is answered. Thank you.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp02_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)], I would like to
consult
you
on
something.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_00

entries.text: Lately, I feel that...something is the matter with\nme.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_01

entries.text: I sometimes feel an ache within my chest, and my\nappetite is dampened.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_02

entries.text: But when I go to the nurse’s office, I am told that\nnothing is amiss.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_03

entries.text: Is it possible that my symptoms are the result\nof some sort of physiological change?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_04

entries.text: Any ideas what it could be?
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_select_01

entries.text: When do your symptoms occur?
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_select_02

entries.text: I have no idea whatsoever.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_05

entries.text: They occur with no regularity whatsoever.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_05b

entries.text: I suppose the sole common factor is that...these\nsymptoms arise when I think of Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_06

entries.text: But surely no causal relationship can be found\nthere.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_sp03_07

entries.text: I note that my symptoms have abated during\nour conversation, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_00

entries.text: It may be that speaking with you has a\ntherapeutic effect.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_01

entries.text: In order to test this hypothesis, I propose that we\ntrade Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_02

entries.text: Your consent is appreciated. I choose to offer\na Skarmory. I await your choice.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_03

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)] is...wonderful. Thank you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].\c\nI will raise this Pokémon with great care.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_01_04

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You will trade your [VAR 0x0101(0001)] for\nmy\r\nSkarmory?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_00

entries.text: You can’t trade Amarys a Pokémon if you aren’t\nits original Trainer!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_01

entries.text: You can’t trade Amarys such a rare Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_02

entries.text: You can’t trade Amarys a Shiny Pokémon!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_02_03

entries.text:
Ah, wait. Trading cannot proceed as long as you
have only one Pokémon on hand.\c
Please put two or more Pokémon in your party so
that we may advance proceedings.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_03_00

entries.text: ...Refusal acknowledged.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_03_01

entries.text: My proposal to trade Pokémon still stands.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_trade_04_00

entries.text: I propose a battle. Do you accept?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_talkto_00

entries.text: ...Refusal acknowledged.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_cancel_00

entries.text: Then let us relocate to the court. Come with me.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battlestart_00

entries.text: At this institution, Double Battles are standard.\nI suggest that you bring at least two Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battlestart_01

entries.text: Congratulations on your victory.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_00

entries.text: Battling you always brings me a certain sense\nof tranquility.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_01

entries.text: Allow me to express my gratitude by passing on\nthe most powerful technique I know.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_02

entries.text: Carmine taught this to me...\c\nShe said that if you assume this pose, victory\nover your opponent is instantly assured.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_00_03

entries.text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Finger Heart emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from\nAmarys!
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_reward_00

entries.text: Congratulations on your victory.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_01_00

entries.text: Time for me to go. So long, then.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_win_01_01

entries.text: Victory belongs to me. Well fought.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_battleend_lose_00_00

entries.text: Time is finite. Every second of every minute must\nbe used with great care.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_00

entries.text: Yes, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]? What is it?\c\nHas my fine taste in eyeglasses caught your\nattention?[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_01

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]With you around, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], I
can
rest
assured
that
Kieran
is
in
good hands.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_02

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]The [VAR 0x0101(0001)] you traded me is\nwonderful.\r\nTruly wonderful.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_03

entries.text:
I should mention that the Skarmory I traded you
is inside a Heavy Ball.\c
This ball is well suited to Steel-type Pokémon in
both function and design. It truly is beautiful.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
entries.label: coach_bb4kings_hagane_randomtalk_04
